1.Subtitle: Expand Territories
1.Description: Drive out the evil occupiers from the settlements alongside your allies and expand your territory.

2.Subtitle: Collect Blessed Relics
2.Description: Settlements are able to provide you with Blessed Essence and Blessed Relics. Use these resources to make your heroes grow stronger!

3.Subtitle: Deadly Waters
3.Description: Expand your Ranhorn, strengthen your power, and cross the treacherous waters with your teammates.

4.Subtitle: Overcome Evil Bosses
4.Description: Navigate the waters, regain sanity, and defeat the sinister shadows of the dark realm.

5.Subtitle: Claim Rewards
5.Description: The sinful beast will be vanquished, and the enslaved mortals will be reborn. Under the clear blue sky, we will praise the heroic deeds of the warriors in the name of the Dragons.
